scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run validate:deployment
scripts.build:e2e: tsc -b && VITE_ENABLE_TEST_CONTROLS=true vite build && npm run validate:deployment
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:production && npm run test:e2e:demo && npm run test:e2e:ios
scripts.test:e2e:production: npm run build && playwright test e2e/deployment.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:demo: npm run build:e2e && playwright test e2e/app.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ios: npm run build && playwright test e2e/ios-audio.spec.ts
